en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4627 - Al-Fudayl narrated from Abu Abdullah (as).
I said to Imam (as): "There is something people say, that most of the inhabitants of Hell on the Day of Judgment will be women."
Imam (as) replied: "How can that be, when a man may marry a thousand women of this world in the Hereafter, all within a single palace made of one pearl?"
